_comment: Seed move taxonomy. A node = one atomic, drillable move (finer than a topic tag). Mastery is NEVER stored here — it is derived at query time from evidence.json dates. Split a node (fission) when a stumble reveals a hidden sub-move inside it. `added` = the date the node entered the taxonomy (first commit, clamped back to its earliest evidence).

nodes.name: Set membership test
nodes.desc: Build a set, ask 'is this value in it?' in O(1).
nodes.hint: The set exists only to answer 'in?' queries; if counts matter it is counter-build.
nodes.drill: Given a list of words and an allowed-chars string, count words using only allowed chars.

nodes.name: Set algebra
nodes.desc: Union, intersection (&), difference (-), symmetric difference on sets.
nodes.hint: Whole-set operators between two sets; a single membership test is set-membership.
nodes.drill: Given two arrays, list distinct values in exactly one of them.

nodes.name: Frequency map
nodes.desc: Build value->count with Counter/defaultdict(int).
nodes.hint: Any value->count dict counts, however built; label it even when the counts feed another move.
nodes.drill: Return the most frequent character in a string.

nodes.name: Counter as multiset
nodes.desc: ==, <=, &, - and .elements() as multiset equality, sub-multiset, intersection, difference.
nodes.hint: Operators BETWEEN two Counters; building one Counter alone is just counter-build.
nodes.drill: Solve 'can note be built from magazine letters?' in one expression.

nodes.name: Question the counts themselves
nodes.desc: Treat Counter.values() as the dataset (uniqueness of counts, sorted counts, count-of-counts).
nodes.hint: The counts themselves become the dataset (their uniqueness, their sorted order); merely reading a count is not the move.
nodes.drill: Do all values in an array occur a distinct number of times?

nodes.name: Dict values beyond counts
nodes.desc: Store indices, last-seen positions, or mappings as dict values — choose WHAT to remember.
nodes.hint: Dict values are payloads (indices, positions, lists); if the values are counts it is counter-build.
nodes.drill: For each value in an array, record the index where it last appeared.

nodes.name: Bijective mapping check
nodes.desc: Verify a one-to-one two-way mapping with two dicts (or dict + value-set).
nodes.hint: Both directions are checked; a one-way mapping is dict-arbitrary-value.
nodes.drill: Are two strings isomorphic?

nodes.name: Streaming ask-then-record
nodes.desc: Walk once; at each element QUERY the running summary of the past, THEN record the present. Order defines 'past'.
nodes.hint: The signature is query-the-past-summary BEFORE inserting the current element; a plain accumulating total is running-sum.
nodes.drill: Return the first letter to appear twice in a string, one pass.

nodes.name: Derived-key lookup
nodes.desc: Transform the in-hand value into the lookup key (target-n, n+k) instead of looking up the value itself.
nodes.hint: The lookup key is computed from the in-hand value (target-n, n+k); looking up the value itself is plain set/dict use.
nodes.drill: One pass: does any prior element equal current+5?

nodes.name: Solve pair condition for the partner
nodes.desc: Given a pair predicate f(p, n), solve for p algebraically; the solution count = number of lookups needed.
nodes.hint: The pair predicate is solved algebraically before any lookup; not brute pair scanning.
nodes.drill: Solve |a - b| = c for a. How many answers?

nodes.name: Accumulate pair matches
nodes.desc: pairs += (matches in the past) at each step, instead of returning on first match. Each pair counted at its second member.
nodes.hint: Adds count-of-past-matches at every step; the answer is a pair COUNT, not a first match.
nodes.drill: Count equal pairs (i<j) in one pass without the C(n,2) formula.

nodes.name: Running min/max
nodes.desc: Track best-so-far while scanning; answer via current vs best (stock profit shape).
nodes.hint: Best-so-far via max/min while scanning; if the state is a total or balance it is running-sum.
nodes.drill: Max profit from one buy/sell given prices, one pass.

nodes.name: Running accumulation
nodes.desc: Accumulate a total/state while scanning (altitude, balance, depth counters).
nodes.hint: One accumulating total/level updated per step; max/min updates are running-extreme, and a stored per-index array is prefix-sums.
nodes.drill: Track max nesting depth of parentheses in one scan.

nodes.name: Seen-state cycle detection
nodes.desc: Store visited states in a set; revisit = cycle/repeat (happy number, path crossing).
nodes.hint: The set holds visited STATES to detect a repeat; lookups of values are set-membership.
nodes.drill: Detect when iterating f(n) enters a loop.

nodes.name: Prefix sums
nodes.desc: Precompute cumulative sums; any range sum = difference of two prefixes.
nodes.hint: A stored array of cumulative sums queried later by subtraction; a single never-stored total is running-sum.
nodes.drill: Answer 3 range-sum queries on a static array in O(1) each.

nodes.name: Prefix-sum + hashmap
nodes.desc: Count subarrays summing to k by asking the past 'have you seen prefix-k?' (560 shape).
nodes.hint: Prefix sums keyed in a dict to count earlier prefixes equal to prefix-k; array-of-prefixes queries are prefix-sums.
nodes.drill: Count subarrays summing to 0 in one pass.

nodes.name: Sort, then adjacent pairs
nodes.desc: Sorting makes the answer a property of neighbors (min abs difference, arithmetic check).
nodes.hint: The sort exists so NEIGHBORS answer the question; sorting for its own ordering is sort-by-custom-key.
nodes.drill: Find the minimum absolute difference between any two elements.

nodes.name: Custom sort keys
nodes.desc: key=lambda with tuples for multi-criteria / derived ordering.
nodes.hint: The point is the key function or tuple; a plain sorted() with default order is not the move.
nodes.drill: Sort words by length, ties alphabetical, in one sort call.

nodes.name: Bucket by bounded value
nodes.desc: When the value domain is small, index an array by value instead of sorting.
nodes.hint: An array indexed BY VALUE replaces comparison sorting.
nodes.drill: Sort an array of values 0-100 in O(n) without sort().

nodes.name: Converging two pointers
nodes.desc: Pointers from both ends move inward by a rule (sorted two-sum, palindrome, container).
nodes.hint: Both ends move toward each other by a rule; same-direction pointers are read-write or a sliding window.
nodes.drill: In a sorted array, find two values summing to target without extra space.

nodes.name: Read/write pointers in-place
nodes.desc: Slow pointer = write position, fast = scan; overwrite in place (remove duplicates, move zeroes).
nodes.hint: In-place overwrite with a write index; nothing converges from the right end.
nodes.drill: Remove all instances of a value in-place, return new length.

nodes.name: Fast/slow pointers
nodes.desc: Two speeds on the same sequence: cycle detection, find middle.
nodes.hint: Different SPEEDS on one chain; converging ends are two-pointers-converging.
nodes.drill: Find the middle node of a linked list in one pass.

nodes.name: Fixed-size sliding window
nodes.desc: Window of size k: add the entering element, drop the leaving one, never recompute.
nodes.hint: The window length is a constant k; a length that changes to keep an invariant is sliding-window-variable.
nodes.drill: Max sum of any k consecutive elements, updating incrementally.

nodes.name: Variable sliding window
nodes.desc: Grow right; shrink left only while an invariant is violated.
nodes.hint: The left edge moves only to restore a violated invariant; a constant length is sliding-window-fixed.
nodes.drill: Longest subarray of 1s allowing at most one 0 flip.

nodes.name: Stack for matching/undo
nodes.desc: Push opens/candidates, pop on the matching close (parens, stars, collisions).
nodes.hint: Pops fire on a matching partner (open/close, collision); pops fired by order comparisons are monotonic-stack.
nodes.drill: Validate balanced brackets of 3 kinds.

nodes.name: Monotonic stack
nodes.desc: Keep the stack sorted; popping on violation reveals 'next greater/smaller' relationships.
nodes.hint: Pops fire on an order violation to reveal next greater/smaller; delimiter matching is stack-matching.
nodes.drill: For each element, index of the next greater element to its right.

nodes.name: Deque for a time window
nodes.desc: Append new events, popleft expired ones (recent calls shape).
nodes.hint: A recency/time window: popleft expired entries; not a monotonic deque.
nodes.drill: Count events within the last 3000ms as events stream in.

nodes.name: Dummy head + splice
nodes.desc: Dummy node in front; walk and re-link to delete/insert without head special-cases.
nodes.hint: Dummy head plus relinking; plain traversal is not the move.
nodes.drill: Remove all nodes with a given value from a linked list.

nodes.name: Pointer reversal
nodes.desc: Iteratively flip next pointers with prev/curr bookkeeping.
nodes.hint: prev/curr next-flipping in place.
nodes.drill: Reverse a linked list iteratively.

nodes.name: Length/offset arithmetic
nodes.desc: Use lengths or a head-start gap between pointers (nth-from-end, list intersection).
nodes.hint: A deliberate gap or measured lengths between equal-speed pointers; different speeds are fast-slow-pointers.
nodes.drill: Delete the nth node from the end in one structural pass.

nodes.name: Binary search for an index
nodes.desc: Classic halving on a sorted array; the while/mid/move template.
nodes.hint: Locates a target's position in an existing sorted array; searching a numeric answer space is binary-search-on-answer.
nodes.drill: Find a target's index in a sorted array, or -1.

nodes.name: Boundary binary search
nodes.desc: Find the FIRST index where a monotone predicate flips true (leftmost/rightmost variants).
nodes.hint: The target is the flip point of a monotone predicate, not an equality match.
nodes.drill: First index where nums[i] >= target (insert position).

nodes.name: Binary search on the answer
nodes.desc: Search the answer space; a feasibility check replaces the array (Koko, ship capacity).
nodes.hint: The searched domain is candidate ANSWERS checked by a feasibility function; no array index is located.
nodes.drill: Given a can_do(speed) checker, find minimum feasible speed.

nodes.name: Recursive tree DFS
nodes.desc: Visit node, recurse children; pre/in/post order as placement of the visit.
nodes.hint: Any recursive tree traversal gets this label, usually alongside the move that does the work.
nodes.drill: Collect all values of a binary tree in preorder.

nodes.name: Combine subtree returns
nodes.desc: Answer at node = f(left answer, right answer) (depth, same-tree, balance).
nodes.hint: The node's RETURN VALUE is built from the children's return values; combining into an outer best instead is tree-global-across-subtrees.
nodes.drill: Max depth of a binary tree via one recursive expression.

nodes.name: Carry state down
nodes.desc: Pass accumulating state as recursion args (path sum so far, max on path, BST bounds).
nodes.hint: State flows DOWN as extra recursion arguments; results flowing up are tree-combine-returns.
nodes.drill: Count nodes >= the max value seen on their root path.

nodes.name: Global answer across subtrees
nodes.desc: Return one thing up, but update a global best combining left+right at each node (diameter shape).
nodes.hint: Returns one simple value up while a nonlocal/global best is updated from left+right; pure return combination is tree-combine-returns.
nodes.drill: Diameter of a binary tree.

nodes.name: Level-order BFS
nodes.desc: Queue of nodes processed level by level; depth = layer count.
nodes.hint: Queue processed one level per loop iteration; depth counted in layers.
nodes.drill: Return tree values grouped by level.

nodes.name: Exploit BST ordering
nodes.desc: left < node < right prunes half the tree per step (search, validate, insert).
nodes.hint: The ordering property PRUNES one subtree per step; visiting both children is plain tree-dfs-recursive.
nodes.drill: Search a value in a BST touching O(h) nodes.

nodes.name: Rebuild tree from traversals
nodes.desc: Root from pre/postorder end, split inorder around it, recurse the slices.
nodes.hint: Reconstruction by splitting traversal orders; the split logic is the move even though recursion drives it.
nodes.drill: Build the tree from preorder + inorder.

nodes.name: Edges to adjacency
nodes.desc: Convert edge lists to adjacency dict/list, directed or not.
nodes.hint: Explicit edge-list to adjacency conversion; grids walked by delta offsets don't need it.
nodes.drill: Build adjacency from an edge list; list neighbors of node 0.

nodes.name: Graph DFS with visited set
nodes.desc: DFS + visited set; count components, check reachability.
nodes.hint: DFS plus a visited set over an explicit graph or grid.
nodes.drill: Count connected components in an undirected graph.

nodes.name: BFS for shortest steps
nodes.desc: BFS layers = minimum moves; grid neighbors via delta offsets (maze, oranges).
nodes.hint: BFS because the answer is MINIMUM steps from one source; all-sources seeding is multi-source-bfs.
nodes.drill: Min steps from corner to corner of a grid with walls.

nodes.name: Union-Find
nodes.desc: parent[] with find + union; components and cycle detection without traversal.
nodes.hint: parent array/dict with find and union; building components by traversal is graph-dfs-visited.
nodes.drill: Process edge list; report component count after each union.

nodes.name: Topological ordering
nodes.desc: Order a DAG by dependencies (Kahn's in-degree queue or DFS postorder); cycle = impossible.
nodes.hint: In-degree queue or DFS postorder over a DAG; a detected cycle means impossible.
nodes.drill: Order courses given prerequisite pairs, or report a cycle.

nodes.name: Choose, explore, un-choose
nodes.desc: Append candidate, recurse, pop; record a copy when the path is complete.
nodes.hint: The undo after the recursive call is the signature. Which candidates are legal at a given depth is a different move.
nodes.drill: Given groups of letters, return every string taking one letter from each group.

nodes.name: Start-index availability
nodes.desc: Candidates are the suffix from a start value; recurse at x+1 to use once, x to reuse.
nodes.hint: Order does not matter, so an element passed over is gone for good. Combinations and subsets differ only in where you record.
nodes.drill: Return every combination of k numbers from 1 to n.

nodes.name: Mark and unmark availability
nodes.desc: Candidates are everything not currently marked; raise the flag before recursing, lower it after.
nodes.hint: Order matters, so every call loops from the start and skips only what is marked. A cell or index left marked poisons later branches.
nodes.drill: Return every ordering of a list of distinct integers.

nodes.name: Skip equal siblings
nodes.desc: Sort, then skip a candidate equal to the one before it when its index is past this call's start value.
nodes.hint: Comparing the index against 0 instead of the start value throws away legitimate repeats from different depths.
nodes.drill: Return every distinct subset of an array that holds repeated values.

nodes.name: Memoized recursion
nodes.desc: @cache on a pure recurrence turns exponential into linear (fib, climbing stairs).
nodes.hint: A cache on a recurrence; filling a table iteratively is dp-1d-rolling or dp-2d-grid.
nodes.drill: Climbing stairs with @cache; explain what got cached.

nodes.name: Formulate DP state
nodes.desc: Name the state, write the recurrence and base cases BEFORE coding.
nodes.hint: Label when defining the state/recurrence is the work, usually alongside the dp node that fills it.
nodes.drill: State + recurrence (no code) for house robber.

nodes.name: 1D bottom-up DP
nodes.desc: Fill a 1D table (or two rolling vars) forward from base cases.
nodes.hint: Iterative 1D table or rolling variables; recursion with a cache is memoize-recursion.
nodes.drill: House robber with O(1) space.

nodes.name: 2D table DP
nodes.desc: Grid/path DP: cell from its neighbor cells (unique paths, min path sum, obstacles).
nodes.hint: A two-dimensional table over grid positions, filled from neighbor cells.
nodes.drill: Count grid paths with obstacles using one rolling row.

nodes.name: Two-sequence alignment
nodes.desc: Two-prefix state over two sequences; each step consumes from one side or both (LCS, edit distance, delete distance).
nodes.hint: State is a pair of positions into two sequences, advanced by comparing their current characters.
nodes.drill: State + recurrence (no code) for the delete-only distance between two strings.

nodes.name: Heap for top-k
nodes.desc: Min-heap of size k holds the k largest; root is the kth.
nodes.hint: A size-k heap maintained under pushes; the heap answers top-k queries, it is not the process itself.
nodes.drill: Kth largest element without full sort.

nodes.name: Heap-driven simulation
nodes.desc: Repeatedly pop extreme, transform, push back (last stone weight).
nodes.hint: The pop-transform-push loop IS the process; a heap kept only to answer top queries is heap-top-k.
nodes.drill: Smash the two heaviest stones until <=1 remains.

nodes.name: Sort then take greedily
nodes.desc: Sort by the exchange-argument key (often interval END), take while compatible.
nodes.hint: Sort once, then take greedily under a compatibility test.
nodes.drill: Max number of non-overlapping intervals.

nodes.name: Interval overlap predicate
nodes.desc: a.start <= b.end && b.start <= a.end; merge/count via sorted sweep.
nodes.hint: The pairwise overlap predicate or sorted merge of intervals; +1/-1 boundary events are event-sweep.
nodes.drill: Merge a list of possibly-overlapping intervals.

nodes.name: XOR cancellation
nodes.desc: x^x=0, x^0=x: duplicates vanish under XOR reduction.
nodes.hint: XOR chosen so duplicates cancel; general bit visiting is bit-iterate.
nodes.drill: Find the element appearing once where all others appear twice.

nodes.name: Walk the bits
nodes.desc: Shift/AND to visit bits; popcount; compare numbers bitwise.
nodes.hint: A loop over bits with shifts and masks; a single XOR-cancel trick is xor-cancellation.
nodes.drill: Count differing bits between two ints.

nodes.name: Digit/base decomposition
nodes.desc: divmod loops to peel digits or convert bases.
nodes.hint: Digit peeling or base conversion by divmod.
nodes.drill: Sum the digits of n without str().

nodes.name: GCD/LCM reasoning
nodes.desc: Euclid's gcd and where divisibility structure hides (gcd of array, common factors).
nodes.hint: Euclid's algorithm, or the answer hides in divisibility structure.
nodes.drill: Count common factors of a and b via gcd.

nodes.name: Closed-form pair counting
nodes.desc: C(n,2)=n(n-1)/2 per group; batch alternative to streaming pair accumulation.
nodes.hint: Closed-form n(n-1)/2 per group AFTER counting; incremental pair counting during the scan is streaming-accumulate-pairs.
nodes.drill: Count equal pairs from a frequency map in one expression.

nodes.name: Modulo for circularity
nodes.desc: % for wraparound indexing, cyclic distance, periodic schedules.
nodes.hint: % for wraparound, parity, or periodic position; not digit peeling.
nodes.drill: Min moves between two letters on a circular A-Z wheel.

nodes.name: Split/transform/join
nodes.desc: Decompose string, transform parts, reassemble (words, prefixes, normalization).
nodes.hint: split/join/slice pipelines that rebuild a string; label it even when it only feeds another move.
nodes.drill: Reverse word order in a sentence, normalizing spaces.

nodes.name: Trie build and walk
nodes.desc: Nested-dict character tree; insert and prefix-walk.
nodes.hint: Nested-dict character tree, insert and prefix-walk.
nodes.drill: Insert 3 words; check a prefix and a full word.

nodes.name: Lazy eviction from a heap
nodes.desc: Leave stale entries in the heap; on peek/pop, discard tops that fail a validity check (index left the window, value outdated) until the top is live.
nodes.hint: Stale entries stay in the heap until they surface invalid at the top; eager removal is not the move.
nodes.drill: Sliding window max via max-heap of (val, idx): pop while the top's idx is outside the window.

nodes.name: Multi-source BFS
nodes.desc: Seed the BFS queue with every source at distance 0, then expand in rings; each cell's first visit is its distance to the nearest source.
nodes.hint: The queue STARTS with every source at distance 0; one start point is graph-bfs-shortest.
nodes.drill: Grid of 0s and 1s: fill each 1 with its distance to the nearest 0.

nodes.name: Prefix/suffix two-pass
nodes.desc: Scan left-to-right recording a running quantity, scan right-to-left recording its mirror, then combine the two per index.
nodes.hint: Two opposite-direction passes combined per index; one stored prefix array queried by subtraction is prefix-sums.
nodes.drill: Given heights, output min(max left of i, max right of i) for each i in two passes.

nodes.name: Stack of partial state
nodes.desc: Entering a nested scope or higher-precedence region, push the partial result and context; when it closes, pop and combine.
nodes.hint: Push the partial result and context at scope open, pop and combine at close; matching delimiters alone is stack-matching.
nodes.drill: Evaluate '3+2*2-1' with a stack of signed terms, summing at the end.

nodes.name: Recursive descent parsing
nodes.desc: Grammar rule -> function, all sharing one cursor; a bracketed sub-expression is a recursive call, precedence is one function per level.
nodes.hint: One function per grammar rule, all sharing one cursor.
nodes.drill: Parse and evaluate '12-(3+4)' with one function per grammar rule and a shared cursor.

nodes.name: Event sweep
nodes.desc: Turn intervals into +1/-1 boundary events, sort them, sweep once keeping a running count (or heap) of what's active.
nodes.hint: Intervals become sorted +1/-1 events swept with a running count; direct pairwise tests are interval-overlap.
nodes.drill: Given meeting intervals, find the max number happening at once via +1/-1 events.

nodes.name: Rotated-array half-pick
nodes.desc: At each binary-search step, compare mid against an end to decide which half is sorted, then pick the half that can contain the target/min.
nodes.hint: The mid-vs-end comparison decides which half is sorted.
nodes.drill: Find the index of the minimum in a rotated sorted array without a linear scan.

nodes.name: Generate-and-test neighbors
nodes.desc: Implicit graphs: never materialize edges. Enumerate the small perturbation space of the current state (one-letter variants, wheel turns, blank swaps) and validate each candidate in O(1) against a set.
nodes.hint: Neighbors are generated by mutating the state and validated against a set; no adjacency structure exists.
nodes.drill: Given a word and a word-set, list its in-set one-letter variants without scanning the word list.

nodes.name: Index-value gap counting
nodes.desc: In a sorted strictly-increasing array of positive ints, index i should hold i+1; arr[i] - (i+1) = how many positive ints are missing before arr[i].
nodes.hint: arr[i] is compared with the value index arithmetic says should sit there.
nodes.drill: Given a sorted strictly-increasing array of positive ints, return how many positive ints below arr[-1] are missing.

nodes.name: Filter, project, order
nodes.desc: SELECT columns FROM one table WHERE conditions, ORDER BY; DISTINCT, LIKE, arithmetic on columns.
nodes.hint: One table, no aggregate, no join: the row either passes the WHERE or it does not.
nodes.drill: Return odd-id rows whose description is not 'boring', highest rating first.

nodes.name: NULL is not a value
nodes.desc: NULL compared with anything is unknown, never true: IS NULL / IS NOT NULL, COALESCE, and why != drops NULL rows.
nodes.hint: The move is remembering that a NULL row fails BOTH x = 2 and x != 2; label it whenever a NULL column is filtered.
nodes.drill: Names of customers whose referee is not customer 2, including customers with no referee.

nodes.name: Inner join on a key
nodes.desc: JOIN b ON a.key = b.key (or USING); unmatched rows on either side vanish.
nodes.hint: Two tables, only matched rows wanted; if unmatched rows must survive it is sql-join-left-keep.
nodes.drill: Product name, year and price for every sale.

nodes.name: Left join keeps the unmatched
nodes.desc: LEFT JOIN keeps every left row with NULLs for no match; extra conditions go in ON, not WHERE, or the join turns inner.
nodes.hint: The tell is 'every X, even those without Y'; a condition on the right table in WHERE is the classic bug.
nodes.drill: Every employee with their unique_id or NULL.

nodes.name: GROUP BY with aggregates
nodes.desc: One row per group with COUNT / SUM / AVG / MIN / MAX, COUNT(DISTINCT), ROUND.
nodes.hint: Collapsing rows to one per key; if the rows must survive alongside the aggregate it is a window.
nodes.drill: Distinct subjects per teacher.

nodes.name: HAVING filters groups
nodes.desc: HAVING runs after GROUP BY and sees aggregates; WHERE runs before and cannot.
nodes.hint: A condition on COUNT/SUM of the group; a condition on a row column is WHERE.
nodes.drill: Classes with at least five students.

nodes.name: CASE inside an aggregate
nodes.desc: SUM(CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), AVG of a 0/1 flag for rates, pivoting states into columns in one pass.
nodes.hint: Several counts or sums over different subsets of the same group in one GROUP BY; a rate is AVG of a flag.
nodes.drill: Per country: transactions, approved transactions, total amount, approved amount.

nodes.name: Rows with no match
nodes.desc: NOT EXISTS, or LEFT JOIN ... WHERE right.key IS NULL; NOT IN breaks when the subquery yields a NULL.
nodes.hint: 'X that never / without any Y'; label the NULL trap when the compared column is nullable.
nodes.drill: Employees who are nobody's manager, when manager_id has NULLs.

nodes.name: Join a table to itself
nodes.desc: Two aliases of one table: employee/manager, previous/next row by id, pairs.
nodes.hint: The relation is within one table; two aliases, one condition between them.
nodes.drill: Each manager with their direct-report count and average report age.

nodes.name: Subqueries and CTEs
nodes.desc: Scalar subquery for a single total; (a, b) IN (SELECT a, MIN(b) ... GROUP BY a) for first-per-key; WITH for readability.
nodes.hint: A query used as a value or as a filter set; a correlated version per row is the slow form.
nodes.drill: Percentage of all users registered per contest; sales in each product's first year.

nodes.name: Date arithmetic and buckets
nodes.desc: Previous calendar day, day differences, month buckets; dialect map: sqlite date()/julianday()/strftime, MySQL DATEDIFF/DATE_FORMAT, Postgres date - 1/date_trunc, Presto date_add/date_trunc.
nodes.hint: 'Yesterday' means the date, not the previous row; 'per month' means grouping on a derived bucket.
nodes.drill: Days warmer than the previous calendar day; monthly transaction summaries.

nodes.name: UNION ALL to stack
nodes.desc: UNION ALL to stack both directions of a symmetric relation or to unpivot columns into rows; UNION dedupes and is usually wrong for counting.
nodes.hint: A count that must see a row from both sides, or columns that should have been rows.
nodes.drill: Who has the most friends, counting both requester and accepter.

nodes.name: Keep one row per key
nodes.desc: GROUP BY key with MIN(id) (or MAX) to pick the survivor, then join or IN to fetch its row.
nodes.hint: Duplicates on a natural key, one survivor by a rule; the window form is sql-window-rank rung 3.
nodes.drill: Keep the smallest id per email.

nodes.name: Nth highest with a NULL fallback
nodes.desc: DISTINCT + ORDER BY + LIMIT/OFFSET wrapped as a scalar subquery so a missing Nth yields one NULL row; or MAX below MAX.
nodes.hint: 'Second highest, NULL if none': the empty-result-vs-NULL-row distinction is the move.
nodes.drill: Second highest distinct salary, or NULL.

nodes.name: String functions and string aggregation
nodes.desc: UPPER/LOWER/SUBSTR/concatenation, LIKE patterns; GROUP_CONCAT / STRING_AGG / ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG()) with DISTINCT and order.
nodes.hint: Transforming text per row, or collapsing a group's values into one string.
nodes.drill: Capitalise names; comma-joined distinct products per date.

nodes.name: Ranking windows
nodes.desc: ROW_NUMBER / RANK / DENSE_RANK OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...), filtered in an outer query: top-N per group, dedupe-latest.
nodes.hint: Rows survive with a rank attached; the filter on the rank must sit outside the window's query.
nodes.drill: Dense-rank scores; top three salaries per department; latest reading per sensor.

nodes.name: Running and moving aggregates
nodes.desc: SUM/AVG/COUNT OVER (ORDER BY ...) for prefix totals; ROWS BETWEEN n PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW for moving windows.
nodes.hint: Each row sees a total over rows up to it; a fixed-width window needs an explicit frame.
nodes.drill: Last person to fit in the bus; seven-day moving average.

nodes.name: LAG and LEAD
nodes.desc: LAG(col) / LEAD(col) OVER (ORDER BY ...) to compare a row with its neighbour: consecutive values, period-over-period change.
nodes.hint: 'Previous row' or 'next row' in an ordering; replaces a self-join on id - 1.
nodes.drill: Numbers appearing three times in a row; month-over-month change.

nodes.name: Gaps and islands
nodes.desc: value - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY value) is constant within a consecutive run; group on it to measure runs (streaks, sessions).
